goal: Deepen a flagship: give a site owner watching Search Console (or any over-dispersed count) a setting that hears 20% falls without weekly false alerts
notes: Pre-registered round, three stages. A (tuning, seeds 101-120, cv 0.15/0.30): pelt + NB picked over pelt + NB1 (161 vs 156 10%+20% falls heard); windowed pass at 0.1/0.05 too noisy at cv 0.30. B (fresh 301-340): 20% falls 115/120 vs Quiet 38/120 at cv 0.15, 88 vs 17 at cv 0.30; false 0.83 and 1.33 per 1,000 days; G1-G3 pass. C (hint round, 11 cells, seeds 2001-2200, 36 min): ladder (default, middle, pelt) vs (default, pelt): false +0.37 (0.24-0.50), steps +49 (36-62), F1-F2-D1-D2 pass. Middle alone was best (1.53 false, 1,140 steps): next round is middle as count default. Real shop (UCI): with --period 7 the hint now picks Middle; alerts Easter and 2011-09-19 inside the autumn climb.
